title: Could your town fit in its stadium?
excerpt: Beaver Stadium could seat its township 9.9 times over and Clones could fit in St Tiernach's Park 15.4 times. I found every sports ground in the world bigger than its town, and checked each one by hand.
seo_description: 190 sports venues have more seats than their town has people: Beaver Stadium, MetLife, Irish GAA grounds such as Clones, and Bolton.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Could your town fit in its stadium?' beside a map of Britain and Ireland with stadiums as coloured circles, the reddest in Ireland, and the line Beaver Stadium: 106,572 seats, a township of 10,762.
